units.source_text: 天色全黑了，源氏公子教人把灯火移近座旁，

en.t: The sky had grown completely dark, and Prince Genji ordered the lamps to be brought closer to his seat,

units.source_text: 命几个亲近的侍女坐在身旁，相与闲谈。

en.t: then had several of his close gentlewomen sit beside him, and they talked idly together.

units.source_text: 其中有一个名叫中纳言君的，早就与公子暗中有染。

en.t: Among them was one called Chuunagon no Kimi, who had long been secretly involved with the prince.

units.source_text: 但公子现正居丧，全不涉及此种关系。

en.t: But the prince was now in mourning, and he did not touch on such a relationship at all.

units.source_text: 众侍女看着他，都在心中赞叹：“到底是个有气节的人！”

en.t: As the gentlewomen watched him, they all admired him inwardly, thinking, "He truly is a man of principle."

units.source_text: 公子便和她们亲切地闲话世间种种普通事情。

en.t: The prince then chatted warmly with them about all sorts of ordinary matters in the world.

units.source_text: 后来公子说：“近来大家都摒除了外间一切事情，团聚在此，倒比夫人在世之时更加亲切了。

en.t: After a while the prince said, "Lately everyone has put aside all outside affairs and gathered here, and we have become even closer than when my lady was alive.

units.source_text: 但想起了以后不能常常如此，怎不教人恋恋不舍？

en.t: But when I think that in the future we cannot always be like this, how could it not make one reluctant to part?

units.source_text: 死别的悲恸且不说，仅乎想起此事，也就教人伤心难堪了。”

en.t: Leaving aside the grief of being parted by death, merely thinking of this is enough to make one unbearably sad."

units.source_text: 众侍女听了这话都吞声饮泣。

en.t: When the gentlewomen heard these words, they all stifled their voices and wept softly.

units.source_text: 有一人说道：“说起那桩不可挽回之事，只觉得黯然销魂。

en.t: One of them said, "When we speak of that irreversible matter, I feel only a darkness that seems to consume the soul.
But that is something nothing can be done about now.

units.source_text: 想起了公子今后将离开此地，另赴他处，不复回顾，真教我们……”

en.t: When we think that from now on you will leave this place, go elsewhere, and never look back again, it makes us..."

units.source_text: 她说到这里，喉头哽咽，说不下去了。

en.t: At this point her throat choked with emotion, and she could say no more.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看看众侍女，觉得她们很可怜，便答道：“岂有不复回顾之理？

en.t: Prince Genji looked at the gentlewomen, felt deep pity for them, and replied, "How could there be any reason for me never to look back?

units.source_text: 你们不要把我看作如此薄情之人！

en.t: You must not think of me as such a heartless man.

units.source_text: 倘有眼光长远的人，定能了解我的衷心。

en.t: Anyone with a long view will surely understand my true feelings.

units.source_text: 不过我的寿命也是修短无常的啊！”

en.t: Only, my own lifespan too may be long or short; there is no knowing."

units.source_text: 他的眼睛注视灯火，泪盈于睫，神情十分凄艳。

en.t: His eyes were fixed on the lamplight, tears brimmed on his lashes, and his expression was both deeply sorrowful and exquisitely beautiful.
